newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian defence minister to visit Asia.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian defence minister to visit Asia.

text.p: Australian Defence Minister Ian McLachlan said on Monday he would discuss regional security and bilateral defence co-operation during a visit to the Philippines and Indonesia this week.
McLachlan is due to fly to Manila on Tuesday, where he will meet President Fidel Ramos, Defence Secretary Renato de Villa and senior defence officials, he said in a statement.

"The Philippines armed forces' modernisation programme provides good opportunities to develop co-operation further, particularly in the areas of defence capability planning, project and logistics management and combined exercising," McLachlan said.
He will travel to Indonesia for the second annual meeting of defence ministers from Australia and Indonesia in the east Java city of Surabaya on Thursday.
"Australia's defence relationship with Indonesia is a key element of Australia's approach to regional engagement," he said.
McLachlan returns to Australia on Friday.
